BUG in `gsDirichletValues`: The `gsDirichletValuesByTPInterpolation` is based on `TPInterpolation`, indeed, tensor-product interpolation. Since it calls ``` for ( int i=0; i < parDim; ++i) {     if ( i==dir )     {         b[0] = ( basis.component(i).support() ) (0, param);         rr.push_back(b);     }     else     {         rr.push_back( basis.component(i).anchors().transpose() );     } } ``` It takes `basis.component(i)` for `gsHTensorBasis` which is ``` m_bases[ this->maxLevel() ]->component(i); ``` So it interpolates on the wrong anchors.
